_comment: Hand-checked tags for each paper, keyed by DOI (lower case). The weekly sync rewrites publications.json and never touches this file, so tags survive it; a paper the sync adds simply shows without tags until an entry is added here. Every tag was read off the paper itself (abstract or Methods). A tag is left out when the paper does not say it: an empty list means 'not stated', never 'none'. design / data / links use the ids in src/data/research.ts. countries are ISO alpha-2 codes, plus two pseudo codes: GLOBAL (a federated network whose countries the paper does not itemise) and MIDAS65 (the 65 countries and regions of the IQVIA MIDAS sales data, listed in research.ts). `links` lists every tool on the site that fits the paper; none is shown unless its id is also in the paper's optional `featured` list (at most two show). No paper has `featured` set as of 2026-11-19.

10.1016/j.lanwpc.2026.102014.source: Methods, Data sources: NHIS-NHID (South Korea), Hospital Authority (Hong Kong), NHIRD (Taiwan), NZMIDP (New Zealand); retrospective cohort, propensity-score matched.

10.1002/cpt.70536.source: Abstract: TriNetX Global Collaborative Network; multicenter active-comparator, new-user target trial emulations.
